blurb.en: Never written a line of code? Perfect. This book takes you from your very first program to a real web app you publish yourself. With Bit, your friendly robot guide, you will learn how computers think, build pages with HTML and CSS, bring them to life with JavaScript, and work like a professional with Git. Every example is real, tested code, and every chapter ends with a project you can be proud of.

blurb.en: You know the basics of programming; now put an app on a phone. With Bit as your guide, this book teaches Dart from the ground up, then Flutter: widgets, layouts, lists, navigation, forms, state, talking to an API and saving data. It builds every app in Arabic and English, right to left and left to right, finishes with a complete notes app, and takes it to Google Play and the App Store. Every example is real, tested code, with screenshots of it running.
blurb.ar: تعرف أساسيات البرمجة؛ والآن ضع تطبيقاً على جوال. ومع «بِت» مرشداً، يعلّمك هذا الكتاب Dart من أساسها، ثم Flutter: العناصر، والتخطيطات، والقوائم، والتنقل، والنماذج، والحالة، والحديث مع API، وحفظ البيانات. ويبني كل تطبيق بالعربية والإنجليزية، من اليمين ومن اليسار، وينتهي بتطبيق ملاحظات كامل يأخذه إلى Google Play وApp Store. كل مثال كود حقيقي مُختبر، مع صور له وهو يعمل.

en: Simple, clear language: one idea at a time, short sentences, every new word explained the first time.
Every concept with a real, tested example and its real output.
Every chapter ends with two or three guided practice projects that take the reader step by step, with hints and a full solution in the code repository.
Every part ends with a bigger project that combines its chapters.
Professional habits in every chapter: how experienced developers really work.

كل مفهوم بمثال حقيقي مُختبر ومخرجاته الحقيقية.
